_comment: HOW OFTEN DATA UPDATES, plus the RULES that turn data into risk levels and headlines.
The GitHub workflow wakes up every hour. Each script checks data/meta.json for its last run
and exits early if it isn't due yet, based on the numbers below.
_comment_season: South Florida king tides peak in fall (roughly mid-August to mid-December), when the
seasonal high water lines up with the year's biggest astronomical tides.
Format is MM-DD. NOAA's monthly high tide flooding outlook can be used to refine this window later.
_comment_alertOverride: If true, any active NWS coastal flood or flood alert for any city forces hourly updates, even off-season.
_comment_stats: FEMA flood insurance claims totals (By the Numbers). Weekly is plenty; FEMA updates the dataset monthly.
_comment_alerts: NWS alerts (flood risk + weather alert cards) are checked hourly all year. Pages also refresh them live in the browser.
_comment_stale: A panel shows 'Data delayed' when its data is older than this many times its expected interval.

_comment: Risk level per city. Checked from Severe down to Low; the first match wins.
Water levels are feet above MHHW (normal high tide). Thresholds come from NOAA's
NWS minor / moderate / major flood levels for each gauge (station metadata).
Alert names must match the NWS 'event' field exactly.

low._comment: Everything else: below minor flood threshold and no matching alerts.

_comment: The hero headline (h1) is generated from data, never hardcoded.
Conditions are checked top to bottom; the first match wins. Edit wording freely.
The home page h1 uses Miami's result (decided 2026-10-28).
headline._comment_elevatedMinFt: 'Higher than normal' means water now, or today's predicted high, is at least this many ft above MHHW but still under the minor flood threshold.

_comment_conditions.coastalFloodWarning: An NWS 'Coastal Flood Warning' is active for the city.
_comment_conditions.kingTideFloodingLikely: NOAA's high tide flooding outlook flags today, OR today's predicted high tide reaches the minor flood threshold.
_comment_conditions.heavyRainAlert: Any alert listed in heavyRainAlerts is active for the city.
_comment_conditions.waterElevated: Water now, or today's predicted high, is at least elevatedMinFt above MHHW.
